nodes.name: Ni foam pretreatment
nodes.procedure: Commercial Ni foams (5 cm × 1 cm) were put into 0.5 M hydrochloric acid solution for ≈5 min under ultrasonication to remove the possible surface oxide layers. Afterward, the Ni foam was washed by DI water and dried in an oven at 60°C overnight.
nodes.source_text: Ni foam was put into 0.5M hydrochloric acid solution for ≈5 min under ultrasonication... dried in an oven at 60°C overnight.

nodes.name: Hydrothermal synthesis of CMO precursor
nodes.procedure: 0.384 g of Co(NO3)2·6H2O and 0.272 g of Na2MoO4·2H2O were mixed in 12 mL deionized water to generate a light purple solution. The mixed solution was stirred for about 30 min. The pretreated Ni foams were placed against the side wall of 20 mL hydrothermal reactors. Then, the as-prepared solutions were transferred to the reactors. The reactors were tightened and kept in the furnace at 120°C for 12 h and left to cool down to room temperature naturally. After reaction, the final Ni foam/CoMoO4-precursor were immersed in ultrasonic vibration for 5 s to remove the loosely attached materials. Then the Ni foam/CoMoO4-precursor was washed with deionized water and absolute ethanol four times and dried in a vacuum oven at 110°C for 5 h.

nodes.name: Annealing to form crystalline CoMoO4
nodes.procedure: The Ni foam/CoMoO₄-precursor was heated in a tube furnace at 350 °C for 1 h with a heating rate of 20 °C min⁻¹ under N₂ atmosphere to improve the crystallinity.
nodes.source_text: The Ni foam/CoMoO₄-precursor was heated in a tube furnace at 300 °C for 1 h with a heating rate of 20 °C min⁻¹ under N₂ atmosphere to improve the crystallinity.

nodes.name: Phosphorus doping by PH3
nodes.procedure: Then 500 mg of NaH2PO2·H2O was pushed into the tube furnace to heat for one hour under N2 atmosphere. The waste gas was absorbed by the sodium hypochlorite solution. The final product was taken out when the tube furnace cooled down to room temperature.

nodes.description: HER performance evaluation in 1 M KOH
nodes.source_text: The HER electrocatalytic performance... were examined in 1 M KOH electrolyte... At a geometric current density of 10 mA cm⁻², the overpotential for Ni foam/CMP-350 is 94 mV... overpotential of 197 mV to reach a current density of 100 mA cm⁻²... Tafel slope of 94 mV dec⁻¹... stability test was performed on Ni foam/CMP-350 at a fixed potential of -150 mV versus RHE, the current density... increased by 13% from 12.81 to 14.54 mA cm⁻² after 48 h... The double-layer capacitance (C_dl) of Ni foam/CMP-350 is 35.5 mF cm⁻²... nearly 100% FE for hydrogen evolution.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni foam/CMP-350 shows petal-like nanosheet morphology with size of hundreds of nanometers to micrometers covering Ni foam evenly.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The morphologies of the as-prepared samples were characterized by scanning electron microscopy (SEM). Figure S1, Supporting Information, shows the typical SEM image of Ni foam/CMO before (Ni foam/CMO-350) and after P-doping obtained at 350°C (Ni foam/CMP-350).

nodes.characterization_summary: EDX mapping of Ni foam/CMP-350 indicates even distribution of materials supported on Ni foam.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure S2, Supporting Information, showed the energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDX) mapping images of Ni foam/CMP-350, which indicates an even distribution of materials supported on the Ni foam.

nodes.characterization_summary: CMP-350 shows β-CoMoO4 monoclinic structure (JCPDF 21-0868) with peaks at 12.1°, 15.3°, 23.3° for (002), (222), (204) planes; higher temperatures show phase separation to MoO2 and CoP.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure 2a illustrates the XRD patterns of CoMoO4-based powder samples. ... The XRD peaks of CMO-350 at 12.1°, 15.3°, and 23.3° could be indexed to (002), (222), and (204) planes of β-CoMoO4 (JCPDF card No. 21-0868).

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni foam/CMP materials show Co 2p peaks at 782.2/798.2 eV (Co2+), satellite peaks at 786.7/803.1 eV; Mo 3d at 235.1/231.8 eV (Mo6+); P 2p at 133.9/134.5 eV (P5+ as PO4^3-) except CMP-300/500; CMP-350 Co:Mo:P = 1:0.49:3.66 indicating partial MoO4^2- replacement by PO4^3-.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure 2b-d shows the high resolution XPS spectra of Co 2p, Mo 3d, and P 2p for Ni foam/CMP materials calcined at different temperatures. In the Co 2p region, Ni foam/CMP annealed from 300 to 450°C showed two main peaks at the binding energies of 782.2 and 798.2 eV respectively, which were assigned to Co2+ species.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni foam/CMP-350 double-layer capacitance Cdl is 35.5 mF cm^-2.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The double-layer capacitance (Cdl) of Ni foam/CMP-350 is 35.5 mF cm^-2 while the Cdl for Ni foam/CMP-500 is 42.1 mF cm^-2.

nodes.characterization_summary: In situ ATR-IR spectra of CMP-350 show O-H bending/stretching at 1631/3240 cm^-1 indicating enhanced H-containing groups; P-O stretching modes at 1110, 1232 cm^-1 (P-O-Co), 1392 cm^-1 (terminal P=O); OH concentration decreases and P-O peaks change with negative potential.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The peaks at 1631 and 3240 cm^-1 could be related to O-H bending and O-H stretching vibrations respectively ... The peaks at 1110 and 1232 cm^-1 can be assigned to the P-O stretching modes with oxygen bridging to a second metal ion, hence to P-O-Co groups.

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM confirms β-CoMoO4 planes preserved in Ni foam/CMP-350 after 24h chronoamperometry at 100 mV overpotential.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure S6, Supporting Information, shows the TEM images of Ni foam/CMP-350 before ... and after ... the chronoamperometry test at a 100 mV overpotential for 24 h. The planes of β-CoMoO4 could be found on both images.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni foam/CMP-350 shows small Rct value indicating high electrical conductivity and improved charge-transfer capability.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure 3c illustrates the electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) spectra of the catalysts ... The excellent catalytic performance of Ni foam/CMP-350 is mirrored from its small Rct value determined via the measurements.
